fence_settings_description: Draw a fence around the area the child is supposed to stay in, by clicking the corners on the camera image. The device then watches that area while it is streaming video, and can tell you when something moves inside it, when something moves outside it, and when the area has been still long enough that the child is probably asleep.
fence_motion_note: The fence reacts to movement, not to the child itself. A child lying still and an empty crib look the same to it, so treat "asleep" as "nothing has moved for a while".
min_motion_area: Ignore movement smaller than (% of the area)
alert_on_motion: Alert on movement inside the fence
alert_on_outside: Alert on movement outside the fence
fence_needs_video: Start the observe mode to get a picture from the camera to draw on. You can draw the fence without it, but you will be drawing blind.
loading_snapshot: Getting a picture from the camera...
fence_covers_everything: Without a fence the whole image is watched.
fence_needs_three_corners: A fence needs at least three corners.
